MECHANISM: Max-pivot orthogonal value/output frame completion

HYPOTHESIS: Extending the verified 1485-parameter normalized orthogonal-query design with an orthogonality gauge on the first head’s neighboring projection row will produce 1484 parameters while retaining at least 99% accuracy.

INTENDED_EDIT: Reproduce Reference Design 3, then remove one projection-row coordinate, reconstruct it orthogonal to the normalized first-head target row, and apply the inverse value transformation.

EVIDENCE: Reference Design 3 achieved 99.92% at 1485 parameters. A max-pivot orthogonality chart previously rescued an analogous query reduction from 97.76% to 99.79%, motivating a balanced alternative to the failed coordinate-aligned third value/output shear.
